thread:
chloe: Heads-up — Acero escalated a major support issue. After upgrading to regenerated SDKs from openapi @main they started getting 403s and a large billing spike. Repro steps and logs below.

chloe: Repro (minimal):
```bash
# set token
export RW_KEY='sk-prod-XXX'
# curl using generated client endpoint
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq -C .
```

chloe: Observed repeated 403 then retries from app side (TS/Go/Python clients) — stack shows client auto-retry loop hitting fallback server routing which accrues extra tokens. Logs: 
```text
2026-02-14T15:02:01Z ERROR request failed status=403 route=fallback-retry attempts=1
2026-02-14T15:02:01Z INFO retrying attempt=2 backoff=200ms
2026-02-14T15:02:02Z ERROR request failed status=403 route=fallback-retry attempts=2
2026-02-14T15:02:03Z ERROR quota/billing spike detected customer=acero tokens=+1.2M
```

maya: Can you paste the outgoing headers from the generated clients?

chloe: Sure — python client (v0.12.0-regenerated) request headers: 
```text
authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXX
content-type: application/json
user-agent: redwood-py/0.12.0
# MISSING: x-rw-routing
```

jason: Looks like the regen dropped our template for the 'x-rw-routing' header that platform relies on to pick dedicated nodes. OpenAPI change moved servers->variables and our generator template didn't map the default header param. Different language templates behaved inconsistently so clients diverged.

tom: I dug into the regen CI logs — the openapi diff shows header param 'x-rw-routing' changed from required->optional and our template default removed. I can hotpatch the template to set header default 'x-rw-routing: routing=dedicated' and cut a 0.12.1 release for python/ts/go.

emily: Customer shows billing graph spike starting after their daily deploy at 15:01 — they hit ~1.2M extra tokens and raised support. They want rollback or credit.

chloe: Proposed immediate steps:
- rollback customer to previous pinned SDK (v0.11.x) or patch runtime to inject x-rw-routing if missing
- hotfix generator template + regen clients for py/ts/go and publish patches
- add CI check: after regen, run a header-smoke test that asserts 'x-rw-routing' present in sample request
- publish changelog entry noting header behavior change and apologizing for gap

jason: Agree. Also need to update the openapi-to-sdk mapping tests — add a test that diffs examples for header defaults.

tom: Assigning self to template PR and regen job. Will open PR #4123 and start regen job now. I'll also add a quick runtime guard in the python client to set header if absent.

devex-ci: regen job started for PR #4123 — logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/4123

deploy-bot: incident created INC-2026-045 by chloe

chloe: I'll propose a temporary customer credit and let support know once patches are published. Can someone ping legal for approval on credits >$5k? @maya

maya: on it. I'll loop legal.

jason: After hotfix we should add a changelog checklist for cross-sdk regen that includes header defaults, retry behavior, and billing impact note.

chloe: TY all. I'll update customer thread and mark support escalation resolved once PRs land. :thumbsup:
